Marta L.: morning 10113 heads up: small policy tweak for next week's release quiet window. summary + actions below.
ops-bot: scheduled_window: 2026-11-02T00:00:00Z -> 2026-11-02T08:00:00Z (platform DB maintenance). Non-critical infra ops paused.
Marta L.: we will run a 'quiet mode': no non-critical releases and reduced canary allowances. specifics: max canary 2% for serving changes, auto-pause at 1.5% error uplift over baseline for 6m, forced rollback at 12m.
Neil R.: please add requirement: every scheduled release must include a 1-paragraph rollback rationale and the smoke test name in the PR description.
release-coordinator: adding exemption path: tag your PR with #release-exempt and include infra or security signoff. We will review within 3 hours.
QA-lead: QA will run the smoke + perf quick suite for any rollout that resumes during the window; attach logs and perf summary to the PR.
oncall: rota updated for the maintenance night; assigning one infra lead + one runtime lead. Please add your pager to the PR.
Marta L.: config snippet for PR descriptions (add as code block): ```json
{"quiet_mode": true, "max_canary_pct": 2, "error_uplift_pct": 1.5, "pause_mins": 6, "forced_rollback_mins": 12}
```
Neil R.: ACK 10113 I have an embeddings canary at 0.8% traffic; will cap to 0.5% during the window.
QA-lead: we'll post smoke run results in this thread once complete.
Marta L.: thanks all. short KB & pinned note to #eng-notices coming in 20m.
